fine_lines.title: by vs on (transport)
fine_lines.explanation_ar: نقول by + وسيلة المواصلات (by bus, by taxi, by bike, by car)، لكن المشي on foot.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Use by + transport (by bus, by taxi, by bike, by car), but on foot for walking.

examples.sentence: I go to school by bus.
I go to school on foot.

fine_lines.title: I'm 10 vs I have 10
fine_lines.explanation_ar: للتعبير عن العمر نستخدم am/is/are وليس have: I'm 10 years old.
fine_lines.explanation_en: For age, use am/is/are, not have: I'm 10 years old.

examples.sentence: I'm 10 years old and I'm in grade 4.

fine_lines.title: When vs How
fine_lines.explanation_ar: When تسأل عن الوقت (متى)، و How تسأل عن الطريقة (كيف). When is your birthday? In May. How do you go to school? By bus.
fine_lines.explanation_en: When asks about time; How asks about the way.

examples.sentence: When is your birthday? It's in October.
How do you go to school? On foot.

fine_lines.title: favourite vs favorite
fine_lines.explanation_ar: الكلمة نفسها بمعنى (مفضل): favourite بالإنجليزية البريطانية، و favorite بالأمريكية. وكذلك colour و color.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Same word: favourite is British spelling and favorite is American. The same with colour and color.

grammar.title: How to read a passage
grammar.explanation_ar: اقرأ القطعة جملة جملة وعبارة عبارة وافهم معناها، ثم أجب عن الأسئلة. ابحث في القطعة عن الكلمة المفتاحية في السؤال (birthday, school, favourite).
grammar.explanation_en: Read the text sentence by sentence and understand it, then answer. Look for the key word from the question in the text (birthday, school, favourite).
examples: Text: My birthday is in May. → Q: When is Hany's birthday? A: In May.
Text: I go to school by bike. → True or false: Amir goes to school by bus. → False

grammar.title: Talking about yourself
grammar.explanation_ar: جمل أساسية للتعريف بنفسك: I'm + الاسم، I'm + العمر + years old، I'm in grade + رقم، My birthday is in + الشهر، I go to school by/on ...، My favourite ... is ....
grammar.explanation_en: Key sentences about yourself: I'm + name, I'm + age + years old, I'm in grade + number, My birthday is in + month, I go to school by/on ..., My favourite ... is ....

grammar.title: Changing I to he/she (present simple review)
grammar.explanation_ar: عندما نكتب عن شخص آخر نغيّر I إلى he/she، و my إلى his/her، ونضيف s للفعل، ونستخدم doesn't في النفي. am تصبح is.
grammar.explanation_en: When you write about another person, change I to he/she and my to his/her, add -s to the verb, and use doesn't for negatives. Am becomes is.
examples: I help my mum. → Hany helps his mum.
I don't go to school on Friday. → He doesn't go to school on Friday.
My favourite food is chicken. → Her favourite food is chicken.

grammar.title: Describing an animal with it
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم it للحيوان، ومعه is و has و can والفعل بـ s: It lives / It has / It can / It eats. ونضع الصفة قبل الاسم: big ears.
grammar.explanation_en: Use it for an animal with is, has, can, and verbs with -s: It lives, It has, It can, It eats. Put the adjective before the noun: big ears.

questions.question: "When is your birthday?" Choose the best answer.
questions.explanation_ar: When تسأل عن الوقت، فالإجابة بالشهر.
questions.explanation_en: When asks about time, so we answer with a month.

questions.question: I go to school ___ foot.
questions.explanation_ar: نقول on foot، وبقية الوسائل بـ by.
questions.explanation_en: We say on foot; other transport uses by.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
questions.explanation_ar: للعمر نستخدم am: I'm seven years old.
questions.explanation_en: For age we use am: I'm seven years old.

questions.question: Hany ___ his mum on Friday.
questions.explanation_ar: Hany اسم مفرد (من أصحاب الـ s) فنضيف s.
questions.explanation_en: Hany is singular, so the verb takes -s.

questions.question: Hany ___ go to school on Friday.
questions.explanation_ar: مع اسم مفرد ننفي بـ doesn't + فعل في المصدر.
questions.explanation_en: With a singular name, use doesn't + infinitive.

questions.question: "How do you go to school?" Choose the best answer.
questions.explanation_ar: How تسأل عن الطريقة، فالإجابة بوسيلة المواصلات.
questions.explanation_en: How asks about the way, so we answer with transport.

questions.question: Jana's birthday is in February. Is it in winter or summer?
The octopus ___ in the sea.
questions.explanation_en: The octopus is it, so the verb is lives.

questions.question: What does "trunk" mean?

questions.question: Amir: "My favourite colour is blue." True or false: Amir likes blue.
questions.explanation_ar: لونه المفضل الأزرق، إذن هو يحب الأزرق: صح.
questions.explanation_en: His favourite colour is blue, so he likes blue: true.
